data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Selomah means 'my deliverance is from the LORD'. This name is derived from the Hebrew root word 'salam', which means 'peace, health, and wholeness'. In Christian tradition, Selomah symbolizes trust and reliance on God for protection and deliverance.

in_hebrew.name: שלמה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם שלמה הוא שיבוש של השם שלום, שפירושו השלום שלי, או האל שלי הוא שלום. הוא מופיע בתנ"ך כבן של דוד ואבשלום, ובמקרים אחרים כשם של מספר דמויות. השם מעיד על השלום והאחדות עם האל.

in_greek.name: Σολομών
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σολομών είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος שלמה, που σημαίνει ειρήνη, αρμονία. Στο Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα συνδέεται με τον βασιλιά Σολομώντα, που ήταν γιος του Δαβίδ και διάσημος για τη σοφία του.

in_latin.name: Solomon
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Solomon derivatur ex hebraeo שלמה, quod significat pacem, salutem, harmoniam. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen connectitur cum rege Salomone, filio David, qui sapientia sua clarus fuit.

in_english.name: Selomah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Selomah originates from the Hebrew שלמה (Shlomoh), meaning peace, harmony, or safety. It is a variant of the more commonly known name Solomon, which was borne by the third king of Israel, famous for his wisdom. In Christian tradition, the name symbolizes the pursuit of peace and harmony with God.

data.cultural_impact: Selomah, a name of Hebrew origin, has been incorporated into Christian tradition due to its mention in the genealogy of Jesus Christ. Its use signifies a deep connection to the Hebraic roots of the Christian faith.
data.spiritual_significance: Selomah represents trust and complete surrender to God. As 'my deliverance is from the LORD', it is a reminder that our salvation comes from God alone and that we should rely on Him for our protection and deliverance from the challenges of life. Selomah is also a symbol of peace, health, and wholeness, reflecting the spiritual blessings that come from a deep relationship with God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Selomah in Hebrew means "tranquility" or "peaceful". It is a name given to remind us of the calm and serene presence of God in our lives, providing peace and comfort in times of turmoil.

biblical_reference.note: The name Shlomoh (שלמה) appears in the Bible as the name of King Solomon, son of King David.

historical_references.reference: The name Selomah is believed to be derived from the Hebrew word 'shalom', meaning peace. It is mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King Hezekiah in Jerusalem around 725-698 BC.

In the New Testament, Selomah is mentioned as the name of an Ethiopian eunuch who was converted to Christianity by the evangelist Philip around AD 34. Selomah is the Ethiopian form of the Greek name 'Seleucus'.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Selomah, of biblical origin, has gained popularity in modern times due to its unique and spiritual connotation. While it may not be as commonly used as other names, it is often seen among individuals who value distinctiveness and spiritual significance. Selomah is a Hebrew name that means 'asking for peace' or 'praying for peace.' It is mentioned in the Old Testament in the book of Isaiah (12:2). In the modern context, Selomah is used as a name for children, particularly among those who seek a spiritual connection or prefer unconventional names. The name can be seen on various platforms, including social media (Facebook, Instagram), blogs, and texting/messaging apps (WhatsApp).
